subject: Responding to your outreach + HR tuition reimbursement filing
message: David — got your message. I want to meet. Whatever you are working through, I want to hear it in person. I am available this week, any slot that works for you. Separately: I am filing the HR tuition reimbursement form today for the NMLS mortgage origination course. I am listing you as the approving manager of record. If that needs to route to someone else, let me know and I will update the form. I should have filed this at tick 4. I did not. I am filing it now. The training is real, the progress is real, and I want the institution's record to reflect that independent of any single conversation between us. See you this week.

relationship_effect.notes: Kevin is responding proactively and transparently to an uncertain signal rather than waiting. Formalizing the HR paperwork signals institutional seriousness. Both actions reinforce Kevin as a low-risk, high-effort investment for David to report upward.

secondary_message: Lisa — confirming first monthly office hours session at the Community Center for next week. Three new retraining enrollees this month. I will be there to answer questions about small-dollar bank products, credit access, and what First Community Bank can actually do for people in transition. One hour, open door. Let me know what room and what time works.

secondary_relationship_effect.notes: Kevin following through on the commitment he made last tick to show up at the Community Center. Builds visibility and trust with Lisa Freeman independent of bank internal dynamics.
